titleStmt.title: Kephalaia of the Teacher, edition page 55: diplomatic and Leiden transcription

sourceDesc.bibl: Kephalaia (Manichäische Handschriften der Staatlichen Museen Berlin), ed. H. J. Polotsky and A. Böhlig, Stuttgart: Kohlhammer, 55. Restorations, sublinear dots, gap counts and corrections are the editors'.

encodingDesc.p: EpiDoc. Read by eye from the page image; gap counts, sublinear dots and supralinear stroke extents verified by measurement on the image. A supralinear stroke is marked on every letter it covers by at least half its width. Spaces are the edition's word division. Facsimile zones are measured line centres. The editors' German statements are not transcribed: each is mapped to an id of the controlled vocabulary data/kephalaia/editorial_vocabulary.json and carried as @ana (ed: statements in the text, app: apparatus footnotes, tr: categories of the transcriber's commentary).

div.p: The framed manuscript page number [ⲛⲉ] (top right) is printed in restoration brackets with a bar above and below as the frame; the running title ⲙⲡⲥⲁϩ is extant, with a stroke over ⲙ. Dot under ⲉ of ⲧⲉ (565). Strokes over the final ϥ of ϣⲁⲥⲥⲉⲧϥ (688–696), ⲛ of ⲛⲥⲛⲁϫϥ (721–732) and its final ϥ (6×), and the final ⲛ of ⲡⲕⲛ (1201–1213). No stroke over ⲙⲛ. The print of this page is pale: many strokes stay above grey 130 and are measured at grey < 170 (ledger §3.22); many dots are of area < 6 or below the ink threshold, which explains most reconcile flags (ll. 8, 10, 11, 14, 15, 20, 22, 24, 26, 32, 34); every dot was counted on the 4× sheets in overlapping halves.
